closeDuplicatesBeforeGrouping.message: Close duplicate tabs before AI grouping

closeDuplicatesBeforeGroupingDescription.message: When enabled, duplicate cleanup runs first and grouping stops if cleanup fails.

commandCloseDuplicates.message: Close duplicate tabs in the current window

extensionDescription.message: Close duplicate tabs and organize ungrouped tabs with your preferred AI provider.

noProviders.message: No providers yet. Add one to configure AI grouping.

popupSubtitle.message: A calmer tab bar in one click

privacyNotice.message: API keys stay in local extension storage. AI grouping sends tab titles and URLs without query strings or fragments directly to your selected provider.

providerPermissionDenied.message: Provider host access was not granted.

replaceApiKey.message: Leave blank to keep the saved key

settingsSubtitle.message: Choose how Tab Sense organizes your browser

tourAddProviderBody.message: Click the highlighted Add provider button to create your first provider profile and continue.

tourCloseDuplicatesBody.message: This action keeps one copy of every repeated URL while protecting pinned tabs. You can also use the shortcut shown on the button.

tourConfigureProviderBody.message: Choose a protocol, enter your API key, refresh the model list, and select the model you want Tab Sense to use.

tourGroupTabsBody.message: Once a provider and model are configured, this action organizes ungrouped tabs by topic. Existing groups are reused when suitable.

tourSettingsBody.message: Use the gear to manage AI providers and grouping preferences. Continue there to finish the guide.

tourShortcutsBody.message: Use this button whenever you want to view or change the keyboard shortcuts for duplicate cleanup and AI grouping.
